messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued for Marigold Analytics — Dedicated private rollout. Change window requested 2026-07-14T02:00:00Z → 2026-07-14T04:00:00Z (UTC). Model image: rwd-infer:v2.3.1-quant. Owner: @mike. Run ID: dl-20260714-1. Please ack and confirm rollback tag + canary plan.

mike: Ack, I can lead. Quick items: version pin, KMS access, HA failover test, observability link. Prefer earlier window if APAC tilt matters.

neha: Marigold wants minimal churn. Proposed canary: 5% for 30m → 25% for 45m. Abort if error rate > 1.5% or p95 latency > 350ms.

irene: Rollback targets agreed. Primary: rwd-infer:v2.3.1-quant. Fallback: rwd-infer:v2.2.9-quant. I'll prepare rollback job. Runbook snippet: ```rwctl rollback --run dl-20260714-1 --to rwd-infer:v2.2.9-quant```

ken: Confirming KMS alias: alias/marigold-prod is in the allowed list. Note: token rotation could affect in-flight sessions — we'll schedule warmup after rotation window.

paul: Oncall standby 01:30Z -> 05:00Z. Which dedicated pool / slices are we moving? Need pool id for ops ticket.

mike: Dedicated pool id dp-44. Plan: drain slice 7 first then shift routing. Canary routing policy: `latency-priority`.

deploy-bot: Job dl-20260714-1 created and scheduled. CI artifacts: s3://redwood-builds/releases/rwd-infer/v2.3.1-quant. Hooks: post-deploy smoke test (smoke.sh), evals: marigold-prod-smoke. To cancel: `deploy-bot cancel dl-20260714-1`.

neha: :thumbsup: locking window 02:00-04:00Z. Mike, please add short release-notes blurb + non-breaking change summary for the client.

mike: Will add release notes and the regression-eval set to Redwood Optimize alerts (set: marigold-prod-smoke).

irene: Preflight checklist run locally: kv-cache warming ✅, batch-profile sanity ✅, kernel selection validated for A100-80GB. I'll post preflight logs to #eng-releases 30m before.

paul: Ops note — rollback to fallback will take ~8–12 minutes to fully reroute traffic for a slice. I'll trigger immediately if thresholds breached.

neha: Confirming stakeholders: PM @lisa from Marigold will be on the channel. Pinging now.

mike: @lisa can you confirm availability during window and any last-minute constraints (data residency / traffic shaping)?

lisa: lisa: I'm scheduled to be online 02:00–04:30Z UTC and will watch dashboards. No extra constraints from our side.

ken: Warmup job 15m prior will run this curl: ```curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/clients/marigold/warmup -d '{"requests":1000}'``` — please ensure tokens are valid.

deploy-bot: Safety pin set to ENFORCED for dl-20260714-1; automatic fallback will engage on threshold breach. Manual override requires SUDO from ops leads.

mike: Approvals requested from @irene, @paul, @neha, @ken. Please react with :white_check_mark: to approve the scheduled rollout.

irene: :white_check_mark:

paul: :white_check_mark:

neha: :white_check_mark:

ken: :white_check_mark: prepping ops ticket now (OPS-7821).

deploy-bot: dl-20260714-1 scheduled and pinned. Preflight run scheduled at 2026-07-14T01:45:00Z UTC. Posting a short checklist to the channel 30m before. Good luck team.
